description: This file defines the DepositTermDetail class, which encapsulates deposit term details for fixed deposit products in the Fineract banking platform. It includes properties such as minimum and maximum deposit terms, their types, and in-multiples constraints, along with methods for updating, validation, and copying these details.

classes.name: DepositTermDetail
classes.description: Embeddable class representing deposit term constraints and details for fixed deposit products, including methods for creation, update, validation, and copying.

methods.name: createFrom
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate DepositTermDetail with specified parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates deposit term details based on input JsonCommand, tracks changes, and validates constraints.

methods.name: isMinDepositTermGreaterThanMaxDepositTerm
methods.description: Checks whether the minimum deposit term exceeds the maximum deposit term.

methods.name: isDepositBetweenMinAndMax
methods.description: Checks if a deposit period falls within the min and max deposit bounds.

methods.name: isValidInMultiplesOfPeriod
methods.description: Verifies if a deposit period aligns with the in-multiples constraint.

methods.name: depositPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the deposit period between two dates based on period frequency.

methods.name: convertToSafeDays
methods.description: Converts a period of specified units into days.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the DepositTermDetail instance.
